reviewItem.question: Does "Health status in the Application CR: The health status of each object used to be persisted under `/status` in the Application CR by default" mean a change to crd-field:argo-cd|group=argoproj.io|kind=Application|path=status.resources[].health (default-changed)?

proposed.statement: Argo CD 3.0 no longer persists per-resource health under .status.resources[].health in the Application CR by default; set controller.resource.health.persist to true in argocd-cmd-params-cm to revert.
